final: WITH major_counts AS (SELECT ma.major_id, ma.department, COUNT(*) AS member_count FROM member AS me JOIN major AS ma ON me.link_to_major = ma.major_id GROUP BY ma.major_id, ma.department), shares AS (SELECT major_id, department, member_count, 1.0 * member_count / SUM(member_count) OVER () AS share FROM major_counts), compared AS (SELECT major_id, department, member_count, share, share - AVG(share) OVER (PARTITION BY department) AS above_department_average FROM shares) SELECT major_id, department, member_count, share, above_department_average FROM compared WHERE above_department_average > 0 ORDER BY above_department_average DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10
